mapper.insert: INSERT INTO db_backup_record (backup_no, trigger_type, status, database_name, storage_type, storage_path, ciphertext_size, plaintext_size, checksum_sha256, encryption, dump_tool, table_count, table_stats_json, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, error_message, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{backupNo}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{databaseName}, #{storageType}, #{storagePath}, #{ciphertextSize}, #{plaintextSize}, #{checksumSha256}, #{encryption}, #{dumpTool}, #{tableCount}, #{tableStatsJson}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMs}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE db_backup_record SET status = #{status}, storage_type = #{storageType}, storage_path = #{storagePath}, ciphertext_size = #{ciphertextSize}, plaintext_size = #{plaintextSize}, checksum_sha256 = #{checksumSha256}, encryption = #{encryption}, dump_tool = #{dumpTool}, table_count = #{tableCount}, table_stats_json = #{tableStatsJson}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM db_backup_record WHERE status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM db_backup_record
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE db_backup_record SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = '备份执行超时，已重置为失败', finished_at = #{now}, duration_ms = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, #{now}) / 1000, update_time = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < #{threshold}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ciphertext_size), 0) FROM db_backup_record WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
SELECT MAX(finished_at) FROM db_backup_record WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
